summary: Riding a minecart cluster into a wall freezes the game
description: Derailed Minecarts that are clustered together often keep their movement speed, which is due to another bug (). In some cases (with the Minecart Improvements experiment enabled) if such clusters of minecarts are ridden by the player and collide with blocks, the screen goes black and the game stops working. It then has to be terminated manually. Steps to reproduce (or use the link below for a more reliable method): - Place around 20 to 30 minecarts on a normal rail. - Push the minecarts. They should now start to move off the rail, keeping their velocity. - Ride one of the minecarts in the cluster. - Wait until it collides into blocks (2 blocks high is best). Water like in the attached videos isn t needed. This is not very reliable, so a few attempts may be needed. Alternatively, the attached world ( ) can be used to reproduce the bug: - Open the world. - Walk into the minecart cluster. - Ride one of the minecarts in the cluster. - Wait until it collides into the wall and locks the game.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Place around 20 to 30 minecarts on a normal rail.
3. Push the minecarts so they start moving and eventually derail, maintaining their velocity.
4. Ride one of the minecarts in the cluster.
5. Guide the minecart towards a wall (approximately 2 blocks high).
6. Wait until the minecart collides with the wall.
7. Observe that the screen goes black and the game stops working.

Alternatively:

1. Download and open the attached world file provided for this bug report.
2. Walk into the pre-placed minecart cluster within the world.
3. Ride one of the minecarts in the cluster.
4. Guide the minecart towards a wall within the world.
5. Wait until the minecart collides with the wall.
6. Observe that the screen goes black and the game stops working.
Observed Behavior: When riding a cluster of minecarts that have derailed and are still moving at high velocity into blocks, the game freezes and the screen goes black if the Minecart Improvements experiment is enabled. This issue requires manual termination of the game. To reproduce this bug, place around 20 to 30 minecarts on a normal rail and push them so they start moving off the rail while maintaining their velocity. Then, ride one of the minecarts in the cluster and wait for it to collide with blocks, ideally two blocks high. This method is not very reliable and may require multiple attempts. Alternatively, an attached world can be used where you walk into a pre-existing minecart cluster, ride one of the minecarts, and wait until it collides with a wall, causing the game to freeze.
Expected Behavior: When riding a cluster of minecarts into a wall, the game should not freeze or go black. Instead, the minecart should decelerate upon collision with blocks and come to a stop without causing any visual or gameplay disruptions. The player should be able to dismount safely and continue playing without needing to terminate the game manually.
